.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r1/task/tests/scoring.toml, task/tests/{gates,scored}/*/judge.toml, task/tests/{gates,scored}/*/prompt.md, task/tests/test.sh, task/tests/tools/score.py, task/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, task/tests/app_context.md, task/task.toml [verifier]
evidence: Parsed every file with tomllib (script run in this review). (1) task/tests/scoring.toml: [gates] render=0.0 constraints=0.0; [weights] functional=0.6 polish=0.2 visual=0.2 (sum 1.0); [floors] functional=0.05; byte-identical to template scoring.toml (sha256 prefix 95f70d6e06aa both). Every gate name has tests/gates/<name>/ and every weight name has tests/scored/<name>/; tests/ file list equals the template's closed list exactly (17 files, no reward.toml). (2) Five judge.toml: [judge] keys are exactly {judge='claude-code', mode='batched', timeout, isolated=false, prompt_template='prompt.md', mcp_servers}; no model/reasoning_effort/temperature/weight; [judge] tables are identical to the template's for all five dimensions (diff empty, including timeouts 600/600/9000/900/900). Every dimension declares playwright stdio 'playwright-mcp' with --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox (lines 8-12). Only scored/functional/judge.toml additionally declares name='verifier', command='/usr/local/bin/python3', args=['/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py', '$APP_RESTART_HELPER'] (lines 14-18), matching test.sh:193 'export APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh"' (generated by heredoc+sed, chmod 755 at 185-191) and restart_mcp.py:9 HELPER=sys.argv[1]. (3) Aggregation: gates all_pass, scored weighted_mean. Criteria: render 1 binary (hro_gate_render), constraints 1 binary (hro_gate_shared), functional 43 binary, polish 5 binary, visual 5 likert points=5; ids unique per file, all weights positive (min 0.5), all descriptions non-empty, no unexpected criterion keys. Gates binary only. (4) Prompts resolve: each prompt_template file exists and contains both {criteria} and {app_context} and http://localhost:3000; test.sh:197-201 substitutes {app_context} from tests/app_context.md (which has ## Application/## Accounts/## Key screens) into /tests/*/*/prompt.md; only the functional prompt names restart_app (line 1 and protocol D line 49, single use). (5) Budget nesting: judge timeouts 600+600 within gates budget 1500 (test.sh:213), functional 9000 / polish 900 / visual 900 each < scored budget 11100 (test.sh:224); 1500+11100=12600 < task.toml [verifier].timeout_sec=13200. score.py (POLICY = parent.parent/'scoring.toml', score.py:10) and restart_mcp.py and test.sh are byte-identical to the template. Counterexample search: a dead/static app cannot pass via wiring - score.py:41 requires each gate score > 0.0 and gates are all_pass single binary criteria, so a gate 0 stops scoring (test.sh:218-221 exit on status 1); a conforming alternative is not penalised structurally because no route/selector is wired into the configuration. Minor non-structural note: scored/polish/prompt.md:12 reads 'gives binary0 throughout' (missing space); harmless to resolution, P3 text nit for other rows. Mixed int/float weights in functional (e.g. weight = 1, 2) are valid TOML numbers. Risk=true because this is source/parser evidence only: raw-evidence-index.json (hashes verified) contains only scripted golden observations and explicitly states 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent' and 'Not a configured judge run'. No RewardKit run has demonstrated that these judge.toml files load, that $APP_RESTART_HELPER expands in the MCP args at runtime, or that both suites produce reward.json; the private check-rubric-schema.py / check-scoring-policy.py executables were not run (manual application only).
